answer: The kernel of the protocol utilizes dynamic opportunity-cost bonds to enforce capital-intensive entry where staking collateral mandates a non-linear decay of rewards as identity counts inflate. Subgame-perfect slashing matrices act as a dune of defensive liquidity, ensuring that any malicious actor initiating a Sybil spiral incurs penalties exceeding the aggregate marginal utility of multiplied accounts. This structure ensures a strict Nash equilibrium where the expected attack utility remains negative under all adversarial perturbations of the verification delay.
